en: Isaiah 24

p.src: 1  Behold, the LORD makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.

en: Behold, the LORD makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.
u.src: 1  Behold, the LORD makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.

p.src: 2  It will be as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest.

ja: じようになり、しもべも
en: It will be as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest.
u.src: 2  It will be as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest.

p.src: 3  The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste; for the LORD has spoken this word.

en: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste; for the LORD has spoken this word.
u.src: 3  The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste; for the LORD has spoken this word.

p.src: 4  The earth mourns and fades away. The world languishes and fades away. The lofty people of the earth languish.

en: The earth mourns and fades away. The world languishes and fades away. The lofty people of the earth languish.
u.src: 4  The earth mourns and fades away. The world languishes and fades away. The lofty people of the earth languish.

p.src: 5  The earth also is polluted under its inhabitants, because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.

en: The earth also is polluted under its inhabitants, because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.
u.src: 5  The earth also is polluted under its inhabitants, because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.

p.src: 6  Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell therein are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men are left.

ja: に定められる。それゆえ、
en: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell therein are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men are left.
u.src: 6  Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell therein are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men are left.

p.src: 7  The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.

en: The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.
u.src: 7  The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.

p.src: 8  The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.

en: The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.
u.src: 8  The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.

p.src: 9  They will not drink wine with a song. Strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.

en: They will not drink wine with a song. Strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.
u.src: 9  They will not drink wine with a song. Strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.

p.src: 10  The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in.

en: The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
u.src: 10  The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in.

p.src: 11  There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.

en: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.
u.src: 11  There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.

p.src: 12  The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction.

en: The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction.
u.src: 12  The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction.

p.src: 13  For it will be so within the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.

ja: を揺すった後のように、ぶどうの収穫後に落ち穂を拾う時のようになる。
en: For it will be so within the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.
u.src: 13  For it will be so within the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.

p.src: 14  These shall lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of the LORD. They cry aloud from the sea.

en: These shall lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of the LORD. They cry aloud from the sea.
u.src: 14  These shall lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of the LORD. They cry aloud from the sea.

p.src: 15  Therefore glorify the LORD in the east, even the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!

en: Therefore glorify the LORD in the east, even the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!
u.src: 15  Therefore glorify the LORD in the east, even the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!

p.src: 16  From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, “I pine away! I pine away! woe is me!” The treacherous have dealt treacherously. Yes, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.

ja: てから、われわれは歌を聞いた。「
en: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, “I pine away! I pine away! woe is me!” The treacherous have dealt treacherously. Yes, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.
u.src: 16  From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, “I pine away! I pine away! woe is me!” The treacherous have dealt treacherously. Yes, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.

p.src: 17  Fear, the pit, and the snare are on you who inhabit the earth.

en: Fear, the pit, and the snare are on you who inhabit the earth.
u.src: 17  Fear, the pit, and the snare are on you who inhabit the earth.

p.src: 18  It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and he who comes up out of the middle of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.

en: It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and he who comes up out of the middle of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.
u.src: 18  It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and he who comes up out of the middle of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.

p.src: 19  The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently.

en: The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently.
u.src: 19  The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently.

p.src: 20  The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy on it, and it will fall and not rise again.

ja: った者のようによろめき、ハンモックのように
en: The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy on it, and it will fall and not rise again.
u.src: 20  The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy on it, and it will fall and not rise again.

p.src: 21  It will happen in that day that the LORD will punish the army of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.

en: It will happen in that day that the LORD will punish the army of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.
u.src: 21  It will happen in that day that the LORD will punish the army of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.

p.src: 22  They will be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and will be shut up in the prison; and after many days they will be visited.

en: They will be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and will be shut up in the prison; and after many days they will be visited.
u.src: 22  They will be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and will be shut up in the prison; and after many days they will be visited.

p.src: 23  Then the moon will be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for the LORD of Armies will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem; and glory will be before his elders.

en: Then the moon will be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for the LORD of Armies will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem; and glory will be before his elders.
u.src: 23  Then the moon will be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for the LORD of Armies will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem; and glory will be before his elders.
